name: Bangui
subtitle: Bangui, capital of Central African Republic: its numbers, a short history and places to see beyond the World Heritage list.

keyPoints.text: About 451,691 people live in Bangui (the 1988 census, the latest one found in a readable source) (counted 1988).
Radio Ndeke Luka reports that Bangui was created in 1889 by Michel Dolisie, a French explorer and administrator.
Bangui became the chief town (chef-lieu) of Oubangui-Chari, a subdivision of French Equatorial Africa, from 1910.

parts.text: Radio Ndeke Luka reports that Bangui was created in 1889 by Michel Dolisie, a French explorer and administrator.
Bangui became the chief town (chef-lieu) of Oubangui-Chari, a subdivision of French Equatorial Africa, from 1910.
Since 2021 Bangui has been a prefecture with 4 sub-prefectures and 10 arrondissements, placed under a governorate.
Municipal authorities say Bangui's area grew from 97 km2 to 347 km2 in recent years.
UN-Habitat describes Bangui as covering 67 square kilometres and made up of eight arrondissements.
At the 1988 census Bangui alone had 451,691 inhabitants, 46% of the urban population of the Central African Republic.
According to ICASEES data published in 2024, the capital had reached more than 1,400,000 inhabitants (a statistics-institute figure, not a census count).
UN-Habitat says Bangui is home to about 41% of the total urban population of the Central African Republic.
In the 1960s the dredger LEOTARD was used to fill in the swamps of Bangui so that industries such as BATA, CENTRACOLOR, CICI and AGIP could be set up.
Boats called pirogues ferry people and luggage across the Oubangui from Bangui to the island of Mbongossoa.

items.text: Bangui was created by the French explorer and administrator Michel Dolisie.
Bangui became chef-lieu of Oubangui-Chari within French Equatorial Africa.
Barthélemy Boganda proclaimed the Central African Republic, limited to the borders of the former Oubangui-Chari.
Jean-Bedel Bokassa crowned himself emperor in a ceremony for 5,000 guests at the Palais des sports of Bangui.
President Bozizé fled to the DR Congo, according to one of his advisers, as rebels took Bangui.
Pope Francis opened the Holy Door of the cathedral of Bangui.
Bangui became a prefecture with 4 sub-prefectures and 10 arrondissements, under a governorate.
